name: LeafPro: la hoja, carácter por carácter
description: Browser-based, bilingual (Spanish/English) application for teaching leaf morphology. A parametric leaf engine draws every figure from a small model (blade shape × apex × base × margin × lobing × venation), including compound leaves. It covers the parts of the dicot and grass leaf, simple versus compound leaves, phyllotaxy with a golden-angle simulator, an atlas of 110+ illustrated terms with Mexican example species, a leaf builder with written botanical descriptions, generative self-assessment and a classroom mode. Runs entirely offline in the browser.
